title: I Put Gaming Powder In Mom's Biryani

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So I replaced Mom's secret seasoning with my gaming powder.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix! Why does my biryani taste like an energy drink?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Technically it's mango flavour. So basically, dessert biryani?

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: He's been selling it at school as a pre workout.

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: I told Mom the second he walked in. You owe me ten taka.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Worth it. Follow for part two, because I'm not surviving this.
